correctness.rationale: The exact 20-edge graph yields 102 independent faces. Seven certificate lists prove actual elementary collapses: the ambient complex and each positive intermediate restriction collapse onto a nine-vertex core; that core collapses to a connected closed combinatorial 2-manifold of Euler characteristic two, hence an integral S^2. All eleven maximal negative restrictions collapse to a point by rotation of three representative certificates. Every one of the 2048 vertex subsets either contains a positive core or is contained in such a contractible negative restriction, so the entire inclusion-map dichotomy follows by factorization. The ten signed Lefschetz sums yield rotation trace +1 and reflection trace -1; integral H2 has rank one. The standalone checker actually executed and verified all steps. The independent mod-two H2 enumeration agreed for all 2048 subsets; it is supporting finite cross-check evidence, not the argument for integral homotopy.

originality.rationale: The proposed contribution is the exact homotopy classification of the 2047 nonempty vertex-induced inclusion maps, five nine-vertex equivalence cores, eleven maximal nullhomotopic supersets, and integral dihedral sign. The ambient S^2 type is already implied by Goyal–Shukla–Singh (Theorem 4.1), and is not attributed to the new result. Barmak’s suspension tools and Carnero Bravo’s generalized Mycielskian homotopy table do not address the actual induced inclusion maps. Indexed nearby Grötzsch matching and Čech complexes have different objects. Targeted published-finding corpus searches and accessible prior ledger claim comparisons found no claim logically implying this particular induced-inclusion diagram. This is a best-knowledge originality assessment, not proof of literature uniqueness.
residual_risks: An unpublished, poorly indexed, or differently titled computation could duplicate the exact Grötzsch induced-inclusion classification.

value.rationale: The Grötzsch graph is the canonical minimum-order triangle-free four-chromatic graph. Its known independence complex homotopy type S^2 cannot determine which induced vertex restrictions preserve global topology. This theorem completely classifies every actual induced map: exactly five minimal nine-vertex cores, eleven positive vertex subsets, and an explicit family of eleven maximal contractible obstructions covering every null case. It determines a natural and sharp local-to-global homotopy invariant, rather than just computing another Betti number or choosing an arbitrary graph slice. The simple dihedral orientation character augments, but is not the sole source of, its value.
